summary: Full backend and frontend testing of MyGenie POS form submissions. All critical form APIs work. Key finding: GET /api/demo-requests returns 500 due to corrupted probe document. ROI Calculator page missing (404). Demo form E2E works perfectly with OTP step appearing after submit.

critical.issue: Returns 500 — corrupted probe document {id:'cr59-probe', phone:'x', cleaned:true} in MongoDB is missing 'name' field causing Pydantic ResponseValidationError. Fix: either delete the probe doc from MongoDB or make the DemoRequest response_model fields Optional.

ui_bugs.issue: /roi-calculator returns 404 Page Not Found but the footer links to it as 'ROI Calculator'. Page doesn't exist in the frontend router.

integration_issues.issue: Contact form at /contact could not be tested via Playwright automation (the MessageForm.jsx sends to /api/contact). Backend curl confirms endpoint works. The form has 'Years in business *' select (data-testid=message-select-years) — Playwright couldn't select by label but by index works. The form submission itself wasn't confirmed via UI due to select option mismatch.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix GET /api/demo-requests 500 — delete corrupted probe doc from MongoDB (id='cr59-probe') OR make DemoRequest response_model fields Optional so Pydantic doesn't fail on missing 'name'
MEDIUM: Create /roi-calculator page or remove link from footer

LOW: Contact form 'Years in business' select options — ensure label values match options (Playwright test failed with label 'Less than 1 year' not found, actual options are 'Yet to open', '0 – 2 years', '2+ years')
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 575: GET /api/demo-requests uses response_model=List[DemoRequest] but a probe document in MongoDB missing 'name' field causes Pydantic ResponseValidationError -> 500. Fix: add error handling around serialization or make DemoRequest.name Optional in the response model, or add a MongoDB filter to exclude probe/invalid docs.
The /roi-calculator route is referenced in the footer but not implemented in React Router — will show 404 to users who click it.

rca_of_issue: GET /api/demo-requests 500: The MongoDB collection contains a document with id='cr59-probe', phone='x', cleaned=true, but missing required field 'name'. When FastAPI tries to serialize this via response_model=List[DemoRequest], Pydantic raises a ValidationError which becomes a 500 response. Fix options: (1) db.demo_requests.delete_one({'id':'cr59-probe'}) from MongoDB, (2) wrap the serialization in a try/except to skip invalid docs, (3) add a query filter like find({'name': {'$exists': True}}).
